ops.title: Modernize cc-notes onto daemonkit v0.20+ (fusekit-first migration)
ops.description: Sequenced migration, own plan required (opus/fable scale): (1) fusekit drops daemonkit/supervise (6 holder files) and repins daemonkit v0.20+, release; (2) cc-notes helperdeployment rewrites from the removed Deploy/Deactivate/Config API onto the v0.17 candidate-plan API (deployment.go ~26 references, pinned by release_contract_test.go:141-153); (3) re-audit deployment_identity.go consumer-build digest and the .app helper plist. Context: note bae31ba (2026-07-24 fleet-audit correction).

ops.text: fusekit drops daemonkit/supervise and repins daemonkit v0.20+, released
cc-notes helperdeployment rewritten onto NewCandidatePlan/ApplyInstalledCandidate/ActivateInstalled; release-contract tests pin the new API
